The '''crystal skull''' was the skull of an [[Alien/Legends|alien]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] headhunter [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac]] hung it on his wall of trophies.<ref name="Wookiee Hunt">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref> By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the skull was in the possession of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where it was kept in the underground catacombs.<ref name="Star Wars Galactic Spy">{{SWArchive|url=play/online-games/galactic-spy|text=''Star Wars Galactic Spy''|int=Star Wars Galactic Spy}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The crystal skulls with the same design are the focus of the fourth ''[[Indiana Jones]]'' movie, ''The Kingdom of the Crystal Skull'', which was also produced by [[George Lucas]]. This crystal skull has the same design as in the movie.
